To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the impact of kinetic mixings at two loops is important in models with multiple U(1) factors, and it should be included when performing phenomenological analysis.

(i) kinetic mixing can have a significant impact on the running of gauge couplings at two-loop, (ii) it can also affect the running of Yukawa couplings, (iii) the impact of kinetic-mixing can be significant for the evolution of scalar potential parameters, (iv) in the SM B-L, kinetic mixing can have important implications for the stability of the electroweak scale.
kinetic mixing can be a significant effect in two-loop RGEs and that it can have a significant impact on the stability of the potential.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of the kinetic mixing in beta function at two loop.
the impact of the kinetic mixing on the beta function of the gauge coupling and the beta function of mass terms at two-loop in the SM B-L extension.
the impact of kinetic-mixing on the evolution of gauge couplings at two-loop.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
kinetic mixing is a fundamental ingredient of RGEs and should be included in any model building exercise.
kinetic mixing should be taken into account in all models where it is relevant.
kinetic mixing should not be neglected in the study of RGEs, especially in models involving several $\mathrm {U}(1)$ factors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, in the presence of kinetic mixing, it is necessary to consider all the beta functions of the model to obtain reliable results.
kinetic mixing should be taken into account when performing any kind of phenomenological studies of the SM B--L model.
the impact of kinetic mixings on beta functions at the two-loop level can not be neglected.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, when dealing with a gauge symmetry with multiple $\mathrm{U}\left(1\right)$ factors, it is essential to account for kinetic mixing.
kinetic mixing cannot be neglected and should be taken into account in all studies where the evolution of parameters is important, such as in the context of the cosmological history of the Universe.
kinetic mixing should be taken into account in all studies of the stability of the Higgs potential at two-loop, as it can significantly change the evolution of the couplings.
